title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Coliseum on 1973-06-22
source: Master Sounbdoard Reel > PCM > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Top‑shelf soundboard capture of a sublime June ’73 show featuring a soaring “Gospel Truth” and silky “China Cat Sunflower”, ranking among the band’s finest.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording, calling it “top shelf stuff” with crystal‑clear sound. The performance is highlighted as sublime, especially the renditions of Gospel Truth and China Cat Sunflower, earning a place in many fans’ top‑10 lists. No technical flaws are mentioned, making it an exemplary listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews award five stars and praise both the music and audio quality; with only two reviews confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, smooth sound described as “top shelf”; no drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight and energetic flow throughout the set, keeping momentum high.
